about.p1: I'm a senior full-stack developer and AI solutions engineer based in Debrecen, Hungary, with over 15 years of professional experience. I design robust, scalable web applications and engineer production-grade generative AI systems — combining traditional full-stack development with the latest LLM technologies.
about.p2: Since October 2024 I work dedicatedly for a tightly knit group of companies: DataExpert (the parent company) and Rubiklab (its sister company). At DataExpert I architect and build scalable, high-performance Progressive Web Apps on a Laravel backend and Vue.js frontend, backed by Python scripts and microservices.

My focus areas include fine-tuning and benchmarking large language models, semantic search with vector databases and embeddings, LLM-based multi-class classification, and tuning generative AI hyperparameters (temperature, top-k/top-p) for reliable, deterministic behaviour.

items.question: What does a production-ready AI integration mean to you?
items.answer: Not a demo. It means LLM-powered features that are reliable, observable, cost-aware and deterministic where it matters — built on solid RAG, semantic search and vector-database foundations and integrated into real product workflows.

items.question: Do you offer LLM fine-tuning and evaluation?
items.answer: Yes. I fine-tune and benchmark large language models, design LLM-based multi-class classification systems, and build evaluation pipelines to objectively compare models for a given task.

items.question: How do you make generative AI output reliable and deterministic?
items.answer: By tuning hyperparameters such as temperature and top-k/top-p, structuring and constraining outputs, grounding responses with retrieval, and adding evaluation and guardrails — so the same input yields dependable, repeatable results.

items.question: What is your core technology stack?
items.answer: Laravel, Symfony and Yii2 on the backend; Vue.js and React on the frontend; Python and FastAPI for AI services. For AI: LLM integration and fine-tuning, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases and RAG pipelines.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
